Lady '''Ines Demain''' is a [[Kandori]] noblewoman living in [[Chachin]], capital of [[Kandor]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Ines Demain}}

==History==
Lady Ines gave birth to her son, [[Rahien Demain|Rahien]] near the end of the [[Aiel War]].{{ref/book|0|23}} She is on [[Moiraine Damodred]]'s list of women who might have given birth to the [[Dragon Reborn]].{{ref/book|0|17}} When Moiraine arrives in Chachin, and later in the [[Aesdaishar Palace]], she discovers that Lady Ines' husband recently died and she is in mourning and seclusion for a month.{{ref/book|0|23}}{{ref/book|0|24}} [[Siuan Sanche]] tries to get close to the Lady Ines, without much success.{{ref/book|0|25}} Soon after the devastation caused by the [[Black Ajah]], Moiraine learns that Ines gave birth in a farmhouse two miles from [[Dragonmount]] on the day of [[Gitara Moroso]]'s [[Foretelling]].{{ref/book|0|23}}{{ref/book|0|e}}
